import sys

def main():
    data = sys.stdin.read().strip().split()
    if not data:
        return
    x, y, n = map(int, data[:3])
    sn = 10000000
    sd = 1
    for den in range(1, n + 1):
        ap = x * den / y
        num = int(ap)
        if ap - num > 0.5:
            num += 1
        left = abs(x * sd - sn * y) * den
        right = abs(x * den - num * y) * sd
        if left > right:
            sn = num
            sd = den
    print(f"{sn}/{sd}")

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
